title: Tusker Burrow
subtitle: Kill Female Tusker (level 15), no quest
steps: In the Facility Hub, take the level 15 portal to Tusker Burrow.
Kill Female Tusker in the dungeon.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Tuskers take 0.25 to 0.4 electric, 0.5 slash, 0.75 bludgeon, cold and acid, and full pierce (1.0) and fire (1.0). Use pierce or fire.

notes.title: Leaving
notes.body: The only Surface exit is at the very bottom of the dungeon, 30 units below the entrance.
